question: Thrissur Pooram festival It is celebrated in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Option 2**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Thrissur Pooram** festival is celebrated in the state of **Kerala, India.**
 
• **Thrissur Pooram** is one of the most famous and vibrant festivals in **Kerala **and is held in the** city of Thrissur.**
 
• It is a grand spectacle that attracts** thousands of visitors** and **showcases a magnificent display of elephants, traditional music, and cultural performances.**
 
• The festival takes place at the **Vadakkunnathan Temple** in **Thrissur** and is celebrated with **great enthusiasm and participation **from the local community.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Karnataka**, a state in** southern India**, is known for its rich **cultural heritage and vibrant festivals**.

 
 
• One of the most famous festivals celebrated in Karnataka is** "Mysuru Dasara" or "Mysore Dasara."**
 
• It is a **10-day festival** that takes place in the **city of Mysuru (Mysore) during the Hindu month of Ashwin (September/October).**
 
• **Mysuru Dasara** is a grand celebration that showcases the** rich history, art, and traditions of the region.**
 
 
 
• **Andhra Pradesh,** a state located in **southern India, celebrates various festivals throughout the year.**
 
 
• One of the most famous festivals celebrated in **Andhra Pradesh is "Ugadi" or "Telugu New Year."**
 
• **Ugadi** marks the beginning of the New Year according to the traditional Telugu calendar and is celebrated with** great enthusiasm and joy.**
 
 
 
• **Tamil Nadu, a state in South India, **is renowned for its **rich cultural heritage and vibrant festivals**.
 
 
• One of the most famous festivals celebrated in **Tamil Nadu is "Pongal."**
 
• **Pongal** is a four-day harvest festival that is dedicated to the **Sun God** and is celebrated with great joy and enthusiasm.
